title: fix(console): evaluate a setting's visible predicate with the expression interpreter, and hide it when it does not evaluate
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6JaoFczGz9PyHzzvPyUf2P99fn)_

- [x] Adds no product-specific widget, dialog, hook or string (see AGENTS.md › Product-neutral renderer)

## What changes

`SettingsView`'s `evalVisibility` compiled a manifest's `visible` string into a JavaScript function (`new Function` with a `with (data)` scope) and showed the setting whenever that failed. It now evaluates the string with `ExpressionEvaluator` from `@object-ui/core`, the CSP-safe interpreter (`SafeExpressionParser`) the renderer already uses for every other `visible` predicate, with the namespace's values bound as `data`. Called with `throwOnError: true`; a predicate that does not evaluate **hides** the setting.

## Why hide on error

The server evaluates the same string with its own closed grammar (`evaluateVisibility` in `@objectstack/service-settings`) and refuses a save whose `visible` it cannot parse. Showing a field the server treats as broken was the console disagreeing with the server in the open direction.

Every predicate the shipped manifests use (comparisons, `&&`, `||`, `!` over `data.<key>`, for example `${data.lockout_threshold > 0}`) evaluates as before. A bare identifier without the `data.` prefix no longer resolves, which matches the server grammar.

## Tests

New `SettingsView.visibleExpression.test.tsx`, four cases: a predicate that holds and one that does not, the relational and logical operators, a predicate that does not parse (hidden), and an expression reaching outside the `data` scope (hidden, and it has no side effect).

Red on `main`, green here: with the fix committed and `SettingsView.tsx` alone restored from `main` (`2958f17`), the file answers **2 failed / 2 passed** (the two failures are the hide-on-error cases); with the fix, **4 passed**.

## Local verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/settings/`: **30 files, 243 passed**
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`, `pnpm check:new-line-citations`, `pnpm check:control-bytes`: exit 0
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the two touched files: exit 0 (3 pre-existing warnings in `SettingsView.tsx`, none on the changed lines)
- NOT MEASURED locally: `@object-ui/console` `type-check`, which needs the whole workspace built; left to CI's type-check job.

Changeset: `@object-ui/console` patch. No issue is linked: this work was dispatched directly.
